settler.name: Settler
settler.description: Imperial colonist. Gathers resources and raises buildings.

grenadier.name: Grenadier
grenadier.description: Bayonet line infantry in gas masks and trench greatcoats. Hold the Line: takes 25% less damage after standing its ground for a second.

musketeer.name: Aether Musketeer
musketeer.description: Line infantry with muskets that improve through the Kaserne's weapon generations. Volley: +30% damage with 4 or more Musketeers close by.

thrall.name: Thrall
thrall.description: Bound labourer. Gathers resources and raises buildings.

reaver.name: Reaver
reaver.description: Fast, cheap raider with a hooked blade. Frenzy: +30% damage below half health.

hexcaster.name: Soul Caller
hexcaster.description: Swings a lantern of bottled souls. Wither: its curses slow the target by 20% for 2s. Deadly to light troops and beasts.

tross_wagon.name: Tross Wagon
tross_wagon.description: Baggage train. Keeps nearby troops supplied: no attrition in enemy territory.

bone_cart.name: Bone Cart
bone_cart.description: Keeps nearby troops supplied: no attrition in enemy territory.

jaeger.name: Jäger
jaeger.description: Sharpshooter in hunter's green. Camouflage: hidden while it keeps still (and until it fires); enemies spot it within 3 tiles.

field_alchemist.name: Field Alchemist
field_alchemist.description: Golden Lane graduate. Patches wounds (autocast) and seals allies in an Aether Ward.

kuerassier.name: Kürassier
kuerassier.description: Armoured shock trooper. Charges: rushes in and strikes hard on the first blow.

rudolf.name: Rudolf II
rudolf.description: Hero, the Alchemist Emperor. Hurls Alchemic Fire and raises the Imperial Aegis. Nearby allies take 20% less damage.

bonebow.name: Bonebow
bonebow.description: Skeletal crossbowman with a long reach (+50% vs air).

necromancer.name: Necromancer
necromancer.description: Drains life to heal itself (autocast) and Raises the Dead to fight for a while.

grave_brute.name: Grave Brute
grave_brute.description: Hulking axe-wielder. Cleaves: every blow also hits enemies next to the target.

shadow_sovereign.name: Shadow Sovereign
shadow_sovereign.description: Hero. Soul Siphon wounds foes and heals the Sovereign; Summon Horde raises the dead. Nearby allies steal 15% of the damage they deal as life.

risen.name: Risen
risen.description: A corpse raised for a short while.

kress_flyer.name: Kress Gyrocopter
kress_flyer.description: Steam rotorcraft (after Wilhelm Kress of Vienna). Fast scout; Aether Bomb (D) hits an area. Only ranged units, towers and flyers can hit it.

double_eagle.name: Double Eagle
double_eagle.description: The two-headed eagle of the Empire, bred for war. Dives on ground troops and tears flyers apart (+50% vs air).

bat_swarm.name: Plague Balloon
bat_swarm.description: A gas-bag of plague over a bone gondola. Plague Drop (D) leaves a lingering poison cloud. Only ranged units, towers and flyers can hit it.

bone_drake.name: Bone Drake
bone_drake.description: Heavy flyer whose fire breath scorches everything around its target.

skiff.name: Fishing Skiff
skiff.description: Fishes the shoals for provisions and brings the catch back to the docks.

transport.name: Transport
transport.description: Carries up to 8 population of troops across water (uses no population itself). Right-click it with troops to board; select it and right-click a shore to unload.

warship.name: Warship
warship.description: Armed galley. Bombards ships and the shore (+50% vs ships).

grenzer.name: Grenzer
grenzer.description: Farmer-soldier of the Military Frontier: gathers and builds like a Settler (80% speed) and shoots like a soldier. Fights 30% harder and takes 25% less damage inside your borders.

standschuetze.name: Standschütze
standschuetze.description: Tyrolean marksman. Longest reach of its age; from higher ground it gains +2 range and +30% damage.

war_wagon.name: Hussite War Wagon
war_wagon.description: Armoured wagon that carries 4 troops. Deploy it (D) into a Wagenburg: it can't move, takes 40% less damage, and the troops inside fire out (7 damage each).

bombardier.name: Quicksilver Bombardier
bombardier.description: Carniolan alchemist-grenadier lobbing Idrija mercury bombs: splash damage and a lingering toxic cloud.

uhlan.name: Uhlan
uhlan.description: Galician lancer. Fast; the lance charge strikes for +150% on the first blow after a run-up.

vampire_hunter.name: Vampire Hunter
vampire_hunter.description: Transylvanian Saxon with silver-shot Aether pistols and phosphor: Aether rounds that purge the undead.

steam_walker.name: Steam Walker
steam_walker.description: Walking boiler with an Aether flamethrower: short-range fire that splashes onto everyone around the target.

skoda_mortar.name: Škoda Siege Crawler
skoda_mortar.description: Tracked steam mortar from the Škoda works. Long-range splash; sets up in 1s; minimum range.

hussar.name: Hussar
hussar.description: Hungarian light horse of the insurrection. Very fast; charges for double damage after a run-up.

honved.name: Honvéd
honved.description: Defender of the homeland: Hungarian line infantry of the insurrection.

kaszas.name: Kaszás
kaszas.description: Peasant insurgent with a war scythe. Cheap and fierce.

aethership.name: Lohner Aethership
aethership.description: Armoured airship. Drops Aether bombs on everything below (splash) and carries 6 troops (board it like a transport; select it and use Unload).

ironclad.name: Tegetthoff Ironclad
ironclad.description: Steam ironclad. Heavy guns (+50% vs ships) and a Ram (D) that smashes enemy ships for huge damage.

kaiserjaeger.name: Kaiserjäger
kaiserjaeger.description: Imperial rifleman with a Girandoni air rifle: fires 6 quick shots, then needs 6s to pump the air flask.

aether_colossus.name: Aether Colossus
aether_colossus.description: Brass giant animated by an Aether core (only one at a time). Crushes buildings (+100%), its blows splash, and allies near it fight 15% harder.

abomination.name: Abomination
abomination.description: Stitched flesh-golem. Its Hook (D) drags a distant enemy into its arms.

ghoul_rider.name: Ghoul Rider
ghoul_rider.description: Ghoul on a skeletal horse. Very fast; charges for double damage after a run-up.

plague_catapult.name: Corpse Crawler
plague_catapult.description: Tracked bone engine that hurls diseased corpses: splash plus a lingering poison cloud. Sets up in 1s; minimum range.

shadow_wyrm.name: Shadow Wyrm
shadow_wyrm.description: Great flying horror whose curse breath scorches a wide area.

ghost_ship.name: Ghost Ship
ghost_ship.description: Spectral galley. Invisible to the enemy while it stays still (unless enemies are within 3 tiles).

lich.name: Lich
lich.description: Undying necro-savant. Grave Chill (D) chills and slows everything near it; Mass Raise (F) calls 4 Risen.

bone_colossus.name: Bone Colossus
bone_colossus.description: Towering construct of a thousand dead (only one at a time). Crushes buildings (+100%), its blows splash, and enemies near it deal 20% less damage.

vampire.name: Vampire
vampire.description: Blood-drinker: heals for half the damage it deals.

bone_golem.name: Bone Golem
bone_golem.description: Slow wall of fused bone. Very tough.

wraith.name: Wraith
wraith.description: Shade that fades from sight while it stands still (unless enemies come within 3 tiles).

prince_eugene.name: Prince Eugene
prince_eugene.description: Hero, 'der edle Ritter', victor of Zenta and Belgrade. Allies near him hit 12% harder and +50% against buildings. Bombardment (D) shells an area; Rally (F) heals the troops around him.

maria_theresa.name: Maria Theresa
maria_theresa.description: Hero, the Empress-reformer. Workers near her gather 25% faster. Theresian Reform (D) fills the treasury; Inoculation (F) heals everyone around her.

blood_countess.name: Morvana, the Blood Countess
blood_countess.description: Hero, a vampire noble. Heals for 40% of the damage she deals; allies near her steal 10% as life. Crimson Lance (D) drains a foe; Blood Frenzy (F) heals the troops around her.

bone_herald.name: The Bone Herald
bone_herald.description: Hero, a walking ossuary. Enemies near him deal 10% less damage. Bone Wall (D) shields the troops around him; Grave Call (F) raises 2 Bone Golems.

rebel_militia.name: Insurgent Militia
rebel_militia.description: Townsfolk who rose for Hungary when their city broke away.

archduke.name: Archduke Franz Ferdinand
archduke.description: Heir to the throne, who survived Sarajevo. Allies near him hit 10% harder; Rally (F) heals the troops around him.

landpanzer.name: Landpanzer
landpanzer.description: Riveted steam tank with a turret cannon. Steel armour shrugs off musket fire; its shells splash. Full Steam (D): +60% speed and +40% damage for 6s.

bone_juggernaut.name: Bone Juggernaut
bone_juggernaut.description: Bone-and-iron siege engine driven by a soul furnace; crushes what it rams. Steel armour; its blows splash. Soul Furnace (D): +60% speed and +40% damage for 6s.

iron_emperor.name: Franz Joseph, the Iron Emperor
iron_emperor.description: The old Emperor in steam-powered armour with a flamethrower arm. Allies near him take 15% less damage. Imperial Flame (D), Full Steam (F).

tesla.name: Nikola Tesla
tesla.description: Inventor of the Aether war. His gauntlet throws a Tesla Arc (D); the Death Ray (F) burns through a single foe.

houdini.name: Harry Houdini
houdini.description: Escape artist turned imperial spy. Hidden while still (spotted within 2 tiles); Great Escape (D) vanishes and reappears up to 7 tiles away.

radetzky.name: Colonel Radetzky the Younger
radetzky.description: The old Field Marshal's great-grandson, with the family moustache and the family march. Allies near him hit 15% harder; the Radetzky March (F) speeds and strengthens the whole army.

jelacic.name: Ban Jelačić the Younger
jelacic.description: Grand-nephew of the Ban of 1848, and Ban of Croatia in his turn. Charges on horseback; Call the Frontier (D) summons 4 Grenzer.

prague_golem.name: The Golem of Prague
prague_golem.description: Rudolf II's clay giant, woken from the Golden Lane vaults.

aether_train.name: Tesla's Aether Train
aether_train.description: An armoured Aether locomotive. It follows its rails; keep the track clear.

grave_engine.name: The Grave Engine of Mayerling
grave_engine.description: A walking siege-crypt of iron and bone. Grave Tide raises the dead around it.

lich_general.name: The Lich-General
lich_general.description: Rudolf's general of the dead, master of Prague's crypts.

rudolf_sovereign.name: Crown Prince Rudolf, the Umbral Sovereign
rudolf_sovereign.description: The heir who did not die at Mayerling. He went into the dark to bring his mother back.

pale_empress.name: Elisabeth, the Pale Empress
pale_empress.description: Empress Elisabeth, raised by her son's necromancy: a radiant, terrible revenant.

sturmtrupp.name: Sturmtrupp
sturmtrupp.description: Storm troops of the Federation with submachine guns: short range, a deadly hail of fire, and armour plates. Fires 8 quick shots, then reloads for 3s.

rifleman.name: Rifleman
rifleman.description: Federation line infantry with the Mannlicher repeater. Volley: +30% damage with 4 or more Riflemen close by.

sanitaeter.name: Sanitäter
sanitaeter.description: Field medic of the Federation: Field Dressing and the Aether Ward, and a pistol for emergencies.

armoured_car.name: Austro-Daimler Armoured Car
armoured_car.description: The cavalry's successor: a riveted car with a machine-gun turret. Fast on open ground, slow off the mark.

motorcycle.name: Motorcycle Scout
motorcycle.description: Galicia's lancers on motorcycles: a rider and a sidecar gunner. The fastest thing on the map.

lorry.name: Supply Lorry
lorry.description: A canvas-covered lorry of the Federation's army service corps. Keeps nearby troops supplied: no attrition in enemy territory.

tommy_ghoul.name: Tommy-gun Ghoul
tommy_ghoul.description: The Concern's enforcers: the dead in good suits with drum-fed guns. Frenzy still drives them.

gas_trooper.name: Gas Trooper
gas_trooper.description: A rubber-hooded corpse spraying soul gas. Wither: its hits slow the living.

debt_collector.name: Debt Collector
debt_collector.description: A clerk of the Concern who collects with a rifle. Patient, punctual and quite dead.

hearse.name: Hearse
hearse.description: The Concern's black hearse keeps its dead supplied, and brings back what it can. No attrition in enemy territory nearby.

szentkiralyi.name: Count Árpád Szentkirályi
szentkiralyi.description: The lich-magnate who owns the Concern: the dead are his employees, the living his debtors. Death Coil and Summon Horde.

biplane.name: Biplane
biplane.description: A fabric-and-wire fighter with a synchronised machine gun: fast, deadly to other flyers, and it still carries an Aether Bomb (D).

zeppelin.name: Aether Zeppelin
zeppelin.description: A silvered Aether zeppelin. Bombs everything below (splash) and carries 8 troops (board it like a transport; select it and use Unload).

gebirgsjaeger.name: Gebirgsjäger
gebirgsjaeger.description: Mountain sharpshooter with a scoped rifle. Camouflage: hidden while it keeps still (and until it fires); enemies spot it within 3 tiles.

corpse_zeppelin.name: Corpse-Zeppelin
corpse_zeppelin.description: A stitched envelope of the dead on bone ribs. Slow and hard to bring down; Plague Drop (D) leaves a lingering poison cloud, and its soul-bombs splash.

bat_plane.name: Bat-Plane
bat_plane.description: A bone airframe under flapping membrane wings, flown by the dead. Fast, and its soul-fire scorches around its target.

wireless_medium.name: Wireless Medium
wireless_medium.description: A séance by radio: drains life to heal itself (autocast) and Raises the Dead; hears everything within a long way.

radio_spotter.name: Radio Spotter
radio_spotter.description: A signaller with a field radio and binoculars. Sees far, and calls in Bombardment (D): shells an area, buildings included.

heavy_tank.name: Porsche Heavy Tank
heavy_tank.description: Ferdinand Porsche's heavy tank: thick steel, a long gun whose shells splash. Full Steam (D): +60% speed and +40% damage for 6s.

light_tank.name: Light Tank
light_tank.description: A fast tracked tank with a small turret gun: the Federation's cavalry in steel.

halftrack.name: Halftrack
halftrack.description: A supply halftrack that also carries 6 troops: no attrition in enemy territory nearby. Board it like a transport; select it and use Unload. Its machine gun covers the infantry.

undead_panzer.name: Undead Panzer
undead_panzer.description: Black iron plated in bone, a skull ram and a soul-gun turret. Soul Furnace (D): +60% speed and +40% damage for 6s.

bone_halftrack.name: Bone Halftrack
bone_halftrack.description: A bone-linked halftrack full of the dead, with a soul-gun on a swivel. Fast and hard to pin down.

corpse_truck.name: Corpse-Truck
corpse_truck.description: A caged truck of the bound dead. Keeps the Concern's troops supplied: no attrition in enemy territory nearby.

frost_dead.name: Frost Dead
frost_dead.description: The Concern's dead from the ice, rimed and silent. Rifles that never freeze; they slow what they hit.

arctic_trooper.name: Arctic Trooper
arctic_trooper.description: Federation polar infantry in a white parka with a bolt-action rifle; fights well in cold and far from supply (half attrition).

hedy_lamarr.name: Hedy Lamarr
hedy_lamarr.description: Film star and inventor from Vienna. Frequency Hopping (D) jams the Concern's wireless and slows every enemy near her; Great Escape (F) and she is somewhere else.

rocket_battery.name: Aether Rocket Battery
rocket_battery.description: A lorry with a rack of Aether rockets: a salvo that splashes across a wide area at long range. Sets up in 1s; minimum range.

paratrooper.name: Paratrooper
paratrooper.description: Jump troops with submachine guns, trained to land behind the line and fight light. Fires 8 quick shots, then reloads for 3s.

monoplane.name: Monoplane Fighter
monoplane.description: A metal monoplane with wing guns: rules the sky (+50% vs air) and strafes the ground.

plated_abomination.name: Plated Abomination
plated_abomination.description: An abomination riveted into iron plate. Its Hook (D) drags a distant enemy into its arms.

radar_truck.name: Radar Truck
radar_truck.description: Tesla's last gift: radar against the séance-fog. Sees very far, and exposes camouflaged and stealthed units within 9 tiles.

rocket_trooper.name: Rocket Trooper
rocket_trooper.description: An infantryman with an Aether rocket tube: slow to reload, murderous against tanks, machines and walls.
